title: D-Skwal 3 Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite is tuned for riders carving apexes and commanding fast sweepers, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1399g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Sporty entry-level with aggressive design and anti-fog visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Carbon-On-Skin composite structure with CFD aerodynamic wind-tunnel tuned rear spoiler profile paired with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation. The interior utilizes Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite: combining France 🇫🇷 craftsmanship with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation and Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Shark's Full Face lineup, the D-Skwal 3 Anthracite brings French engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite represents Shark's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shark D-Skwal 3 Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
